settings.text: Hyperlight Optics revolutionary C60 lens technology transforms light to enhance well-being and visual performance, optimizing your body's balance in any environment.

Hyperlight Optics®️ is powered by patented Swiss technology built around Fullerene C60, a unique carbon molecule that acts as the key light-transforming component within the lens.

When light passes through the Fullerene-infused optical material, C60 interacts with incoming photons and changes the way the light is structured before it reaches the eye. Within the patented technology, Fullerene C60 is described as rotating at an extraordinary rate of approximately 18 billion times per second, contributing to this transformation of light.

Its molecular structure is equally remarkable: C60 is made of 20 hexagons and 12 pentagons, arranged in an exceptionally symmetrical spherical form. These structural properties are central to the way the technology interacts with light.

The result is QUANTUMHYPERLIGHT® - a transformed form of light engineered to be more ordered and balanced, enabling a more natural interaction with biological systems and supporting physiological balance.

Protect your eyes while supporting focus, mental performance, and everyday well-being with Hyperlight Optics®️.

Experience enhanced visual clarity, sharper contrast, richer colors, reduced glare, and less eye strain — especially during long hours in front of screens or in changing light conditions.

Designed for comfortable all-day wear, Hyperlight Optics®️ also supports concentration, depth perception, smoother transitions between indoor and outdoor environments, and a more relaxed visual experience throughout the day and night.

What makes Hyperlight Optics®️ unique is the use of advanced nanophotonic materials designed to transform ordinary, diffused light into a more ordered form of light that is better aligned with biological systems.

At the molecular level, incoming photons interact with Fullerene C60, creating an excited state known as an exciton. Through this interaction, photons and excitons can couple to form polaritons — hybrid light-matter states that influence the organization and behavior of light within the optical material.

As a result, the energy carried by the incoming light becomes more structured before reaching the eyes. This transformed light is designed to interact more harmoniously with the electromagnetic processes of biomolecules in the eyes and brain.

Because light entering the eye is closely connected with the brain and neuroendocrine regulation, this interaction may support the body’s natural regulatory processes and overall balance.

It is this combination of Fullerene C60, nanophotonics and light transformation that sets Hyperlight Optics®️ apart from conventional sunglasses and blue-light blocking eyewear.

settings.heading: Specification
settings.text:
1. The protective layer is on both sides of the lens.

2. Hydro and oleophobic coating: protects against scratching and facilitates cleaning and has an antistatic component that repels dust particles from both sides of the lens.

3. Patented 8 layers of ion coatings: following the Ioncoat K+ process, eight layers of material with different index levels are vacuum applied to the lenses. Ioncoat K+ reduces light reflection to less than 1%, resulting in better vision.

4. Optimizing the Hard layer (HC): specially matched with the anti-reflection process and the superhydrophobic layer, it extends the life of the anti-reflection layer and provides additional protection against scratches.;

5. Fullerene infused into the lens.

6. CR-39 and MR-10 lenses.
